functionDeclarations.name: list_publish_channels
functionDeclarations.description: List the sales channels that can be published to. Only channels whose integration implements a listing-schema provider appear here — use this, not a generic channel list. (GET /api/v2/listing-publishing/channels)

functionDeclarations.name: get_publish_readiness
functionDeclarations.description: Per-channel readiness snapshot for one product — bucket, any live listing, any open draft, the count of available templates, and the required fields still missing. (GET /api/v2/products/{product}/publish-readiness)

functionDeclarations.name: suggest_categories
functionDeclarations.description: Ranked category suggestions for a product on this channel, with confidence and source. (GET /api/v2/sales-channels/{salesChannel}/categories/suggest)

product_id.description: The product to suggest categories for.

limit.description: How many suggestions to return (1-20, default 5).

functionDeclarations.name: search_categories
functionDeclarations.description: Paginated search over the channel's cached category taxonomy. On Amazon each row is a product type and `external_id` is the Amazon product type name. (GET /api/v2/sales-channels/{salesChannel}/categories)

filter[search].description: Text search over name and path. Terms of 3+ characters use a FULLTEXT prefix match (matches from the start of the name); shorter terms fall back to a substring LIKE.

filter[leaf_only].description: Restrict to leaf categories — the only ones a product can be listed against.

filter[parent_external_id].description: Children of one node, for drilling down a tree channel.

functionDeclarations.name: get_category_fields
functionDeclarations.description: The channel's field schema for one category — type, usage tier, allowed values, length limits, guidance, and object sub-schemas. Lazily re-syncs from the channel when stale. (GET /api/v2/sales-channels/{salesChannel}/categories/{category}/fields)

category.description: The SKU.io sales-channel-category id (not the channel's own external id).

include_core.description: Prepend the channel's core listing fields (Title, Description, Price, Quantity) alongside the category aspects. Off by default.

force.description: Bypass the 7-day staleness check and re-pull the fields from the channel.

functionDeclarations.name: sync_channel_taxonomy
functionDeclarations.description: Re-pull the channel's whole category taxonomy as a tracked background job. Run this when the category you expect is missing from search. (POST /api/v2/sales-channels/{salesChannel}/sync-taxonomy)

functionDeclarations.name: list_channel_templates
functionDeclarations.description: Reusable product templates for this channel — a saved set of field mappings and defaults that seeds a draft so most fields arrive already filled. (GET /api/v2/sales-channels/{salesChannel}/product-templates)

functionDeclarations.name: create_listing_draft
functionDeclarations.description: Open a listing draft. `purpose=create` starts a new listing for a product on a channel; `purpose=update` seeds a draft from an existing live listing so publishing revises it. (POST /api/v2/listing-drafts)

purpose.description: "create" for a new listing, "update" to revise a live one.

product_id.description: Required when purpose is "create" — the product being listed.

sales_channel_id.description: Required when purpose is "create" — the channel being listed on.

product_listing_id.description: Required when purpose is "update" — the live listing to revise.

sales_channel_category_id.description: The category (Amazon product type) to list into. Optional at create time, but the draft cannot validate or publish until it is set.

sales_channel_product_template_id.description: A channel product template to seed the field mappings from.

sales_channel_listing_profile_id.description: A listing profile (channel policies/defaults) to attach.

functionDeclarations.name: list_listing_drafts
functionDeclarations.description: Paginated list of listing drafts. Use it to find an open draft for a product/channel pair before creating a second one. (GET /api/v2/listing-drafts)

filter[state].description: One of draft, validating, ready, scheduled, publishing, published, error.

filter[needs_attention].description: Only drafts that are blocked — errored, or missing required fields.

functionDeclarations.name: get_listing_draft
functionDeclarations.description: The draft with its full `fields[]` array — one row per channel field with the resolved value, where it came from, and its errors. Re-resolves mappings on read. (GET /api/v2/listing-drafts/{draft})

functionDeclarations.name: list_mappable_product_fields
functionDeclarations.description: The whitelist of product columns usable as a `product_field` mapping source. Only these values are read by the resolver — never invent one. (GET /api/v2/listing-drafts/mappable-product-fields)

functionDeclarations.name: update_listing_draft
functionDeclarations.description: Set field overrides, images, or swap the category/template/profile. Overrides are merged by field name, so send only what you are changing. (PUT /api/v2/listing-drafts/{draft})

field_overrides.description: REPLACES the draft's entire override map — omitted keys are deleted, so send the union of existing overrides and your change. Map of channel field name to either a literal value (scalar, or an array for a multiselect) or a mapping object {source_type, source_value}. source_type is one of product_field, product_attribute, static, expression; source_value must be scalar. A field whose schema is object or object_list takes an object (or array of objects) shaped by that field's object_schema — this is also how a variation family declares the axis qualifiers the schema cannot imply, such as an Amazon size axis needing a size_class. Such an override supplies only the sub-fields that are invariant across the family; the per-child axis value keeps precedence.

image_urls.description: Ordered list of image URLs for the listing. First is the main image.

sales_channel_category_id.description: Change the category — re-resolves every field against the new schema.

functionDeclarations.name: validate_listing_draft
functionDeclarations.description: Run local validation plus the channel's own pre-publish dry-run. Returns the refreshed draft; state becomes "ready" when clean, and errors land in validation_errors/channel_errors. (POST /api/v2/listing-drafts/{draft}/validate)

functionDeclarations.name: get_variation_themes
functionDeclarations.description: The draft's variation theme, axes, and per-child grid for a variation family. (GET /api/v2/listing-drafts/{draft}/variation-themes)

functionDeclarations.name: validate_variations
functionDeclarations.description: Check the variation matrix for completeness, duplicates, axis consistency, and channel caps without persisting. Returns {valid, errors}. (POST /api/v2/listing-drafts/{draft}/variations/validate)

functionDeclarations.name: publish_listing_draft
functionDeclarations.description: Publish the draft to the channel, or schedule it. Asynchronous — returns 202 with a tracked job id; the draft moves through publishing to published or error. (POST /api/v2/listing-drafts/{draft}/publish)

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime in the future. Omit to publish now; supply it to schedule and move the draft to the "scheduled" state.

functionDeclarations.name: unschedule_listing_draft
functionDeclarations.description: Cancel a scheduled publish and return the draft to "ready". Returns 422 if the draft is not currently scheduled. (POST /api/v2/listing-drafts/{draft}/unschedule)

functionDeclarations.name: get_publish_attempts
functionDeclarations.description: The publish-attempt timeline — one row per attempt, so transient retries and the final fatal error are both visible rather than only the last message. (GET /api/v2/listing-drafts/{draft}/attempts)

functionDeclarations.name: get_product_listing
functionDeclarations.description: A live listing in full — channel, listing_sku, listing_url (the public URL on the channel), title, price, effective price/stock mastery, inventory rules, and the per-location quantity caches. (GET /api/v2/product-listings/{productListing})

functionDeclarations.name: update_listing_price_and_stock_settings
functionDeclarations.description: Change a live listing's pricing and inventory *settings* (price mastery, pricing tier, inventory rules, fulfilment latency) without republishing its content. (PUT /api/v2/product-listings/{productListing})

master_of_price.description: Who owns the price on this channel — one of "sku.io", "sales_channel", "neither". Null inherits the channel default.

product_pricing_tier_id.description: Pricing tier to price this listing from. Required when master_of_price is "sku.io". Null inherits.

master_of_stock.description: Who owns the stock level — one of "sku.io", "sales_channel", "neither". Null inherits.

fulfillment_latency.description: Handling time in days pushed to the channel.

inventory_rules.description: Per-listing inventory rule overrides (masterOfStock, selectedWarehouses, inventoryModificationRules, fbmBackup…). Sent whole — the API does not merge sub-keys.
